name: Delhi Big Cube Open 2022

venue.name: Pacific Mall Tagore Garden
venue.address: Najafgarh Rd, Tagore Garden, Tilak Nagar, New Delhi, Delhi 110018

information:
All the participants are requested to volunteer in the competition and every participant (except newcomers) will be assigned to a particular event they have to either judge, scramble, etc for the group/event.

COVID-19 Specific Information:
* Wearing masks, Sanitizing hands frequently and following all local goverment orders is mandatory while attending the competition.

**Only Participants are allowed inside the solving area.** Parents, relatives and friends will strictly not be allowed inside of the solving area.
